steps.speaker: Curious Man
steps.content: Hey, have you heard? Those missing people have suddenly all reappeared!

steps.speaker: Curious Woman
steps.content: What? They're back? How come there's no news about this?

steps.speaker: Curious Man
steps.content: I only heard about it from others too. One of the missing people is the son of a family in our neighborhood. It's like he became a different person after coming back! He insisted on throwing away his computer, phone, and radio!

steps.speaker: Curious Man
steps.content: I know... But to be honest, this might not be a bad thing. Everyone knows that those who went missing are either jobless or some sketchy characters. I heard that family spent quite a few DisCoins on that virtual thingy...

steps.speaker: Curious Woman
steps.content: I mean, that's their business, who are we to judge? I'm glad he came back safe and sound... Did he say where he went?

steps.speaker: Curious Man
steps.content: No. And on the day they came back, several figures in Public Security Bureau uniform surrounded their house... I hope they weren't sold to the private mines north of the city to dig for Hypercubes...

steps.speaker: Curious Woman
steps.content: Hypercubes? I heard they were tricked into doing telemarketing?

steps.speaker: Curious Woman
steps.content: Didn't they make a phone call before they disappeared? I think it's a call to a radio station...

steps.speaker: Curious Woman
steps.content: That radio station... What's it called again...?
In the gazebo of the neighborhood, a woman sits down on the stone bench next to the two passersby and chimes in.

steps.speaker: Curious Man
steps.content: I think I've heard that name...
The white-haired woman takes out her personal device and puts it next to her ear. She begins softly, as if making a phone call.

steps.speaker: White-Haired Woman
steps.content: No, you don't remember anything. Call at 3 AM, and everything about it... You don't need to remember any of that.
